اصطبنوا (form VIII)
# اِصْطَبَنُوا (iṣṭabanū) /isˤ.tˤa.ba.nuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِصْطَبَنَ (iṣṭabana)
# اُصْطُبِنُوا (uṣṭubinū) /usˤ.tˤu.bi.nuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِصْطَبَنَ (iṣṭabana)
# اِصْطَبِنُوا (iṣṭabinū) /isˤ.tˤa.bi.nuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِصْطَبَنَ (iṣṭabana)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
